annotation.title_clean: Implementation and streamlining of EU internal market rules to strengthen the single market
annotation.title_en: Implementation and streamlining of EU internal market rules to strengthen the single market
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament own-initiative resolution (Sept 2025) urging better implementation, enforcement and simplification of EU single market rules. It touches AI only in passing, calling for a digital fitness check of the interplay of the AI Act, GDPR, DSA and Product Liability Directive, and for regulatory sandboxes. Robotics is not addressed.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for competitiveness checks and stronger impact assessments for all legislative proposals
Demands a fitness check clarifying interplay of AI Act, GDPR, DSA, Product Liability Directive and cybersecurity rules
Suggests regulatory sandboxes and EU innovation hubs for innovative sectors
Urges swifter infringement proceedings and addressing gold-plating by Member States
Supports digitalisation and AI to reduce administrative burdens and a digital one-stop shop
